clips.title: The story
paras: At a camp near Windshear Crag, Kaela Shadowspear sends Alliance travelers to Gaxim Rustfizzle for help against the Venture Company. The cautious night elf sentinel and eccentric gnome tinkerer join forces to guard the mountain pass from the company's rampant despoilment.

In the crags of Stonetalon Mountains, the rapacious Venture Company cuts into wilderness and fells ancient trees. Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel, sees that martial skill alone cannot stop its industrialized pillaging. She turns to gnome ingenuity, though night elves and gnomes rarely agree on technology or the natural world. Their unlikely alliance shows how precarious the struggle has become.

Gaxim Rustfizzle brings the eccentric pragmatism of the Alliance's smaller allies. Night elf society turned away from arcane excess millennia ago, but Gaxim believes that abstaining from magic and technical innovation leaves the night elves vulnerable. He hopes to convince his Kaldorei hosts that practical science can defend nature as well as bow and glaive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The situation here in Stonetalon is obviously grave for a night elf and gnome to be working together.
The Venture Co. Has devastated these lands and I've spent most of my time putting an end to the destruction.
Do not judge Gaxim prematurely; he understands the need for us to work together.
If you wish to aid us, then start by speaking to Gaxim.
I'm sorry I cannot send you back to Tara with good news yet. Perhaps soon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Treacherous... Treacherous and dangerous, that's what this land is.
But I'm here to show the night elves that it's a little safer with the help of good ole engineering and a dash of magic.
See, swearing off magic completely won't help the night elves--they need it. The world needs it. And with engineering and alchemy to boot, you can't go wrong. The possibilities are endless.
